title: Oscar Wolfe deathbed interview about S4 autopsy film and gray alien
summary: Jeremy Corbell tells of Oscar Wolfe deathbed interview about S4 autopsy film and gray alien, about unspecified at Nevada test site and Area 51, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: when I brought Richard Dolan in to interview this man as he was dying on like I think it was like a dialysis machine

plain: Jeremy Corbell is a filmmaker who makes documentaries about UFOs. On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, he says he brought a researcher, Richard Dolan, to interview a dying man named Oscar Wolfe, who was on a dialysis machine. Corbell says Wolfe described seeing film of an autopsy on a gray alien at S4, a secret site said to lie near Area 51, a restricted military base in Nevada, and that Wolfe's DD-214s, the US military's discharge papers, were used to check his service.
